notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - OPTIMIZATION
notes.content:
🚀 Performance and Optimization
✅ CPU Optimization – NPC animations have been optimized to reduce CPU usage, significantly improving performance, especially in the Istanbul map.
✅ Disk Space Optimization – Game file size has been reduced by 50%, taking up less storage.
✅ Faster Game Startup – The game now starts much faster, and level loading times have been reduced.
✅ Reduced VRAM Requirements – Optimizations have lowered VRAM usage, resolving VRAM-related crashes.
✅ RAM Usage Optimization – Memory usage has been improved for better efficiency.
✅ GPU Optimization – Lighting and shadows have been optimized, reducing GPU load.

🛠️ Bug Fixes
✅ Fatal Error Fixes – Various Fatal Error issues have been resolved, providing a more stable gameplay experience.

notes.title: Discover Our New Game: DeTechtive 2112
notes.content:
Hello Compass of Destiny: İstanbul community!

We’re excited to share some thrilling news from our indie development team. While many of you have been enjoying the rich world of Compass of Destiny: İstanbul, we’ve been hard at work on a brand-new project that brings a completely different flavor of adventure: DeTechtive 2112!

What is DeTechtive 2112?
Set in a neon-drenched cyberpunk universe, DeTechtive 2112 combines intense action and stealth gameplay with a gripping narrative. You’ll step into the shoes of a futuristic detective navigating a dystopian world filled with conspiracies, intrigue, and danger.

Here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

Dynamic Gameplay: Choose your approach—use brute force or sneak through the shadows to uncover the truth.
Rich Atmosphere: Experience a meticulously crafted cyberpunk world with stunning visuals, immersive lighting, and atmospheric sound design.
Dual-Language Voice Acting: Enjoy the story in both Turkish and English, bringing characters to life like never before.
Why You’ll Love It
DeTechtive 2112 is the culmination of our passion for storytelling and immersive gameplay. If you loved exploring the depth and creativity of Compass of Destiny: İstanbul, you’ll feel right at home in the layered narrative and stylish action of DeTechtive 2112.

Try the Free Demo!
The demo for DeTechtive 2112 is now live on Steam! It’s the perfect opportunity to get a taste of the game’s unique world and gameplay.

👉 Check out DeTechtive 2112 on Steam now!

We’d love to hear your feedback and thoughts. Be sure to wishlist the game and share it with your friends. Your support means the world to us!

Thank you for being part of our journey. Stay tuned for more updates on both Compass of Destiny: İstanbul and DeTechtive 2112!

With gratitude,
Your Indie Development Team

notes.title: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul - Version 2.1.2 Update is Here!
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

We’re bringing a fresh wave of excitement to the magical streets of Istanbul! With version 2.1.2 of Compass of Destiny: Istanbul, we’ve added several thrilling new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay. Here’s what you can expect:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/35df96ebae7965de38dbdca2296ef67041f93c6e.png

Improvements
[olist]
Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements: We fixed some bugs reported by you and significantly improved the game’s performance. There was a considerable performance loss, especially on Ultra settings, and we applied special optimizations for this level.
Map and Level Adjustments: We made adjustments to the map for a smoother gameplay experience in various parts of Istanbul. Specifically, certain pathways and the lighting that marks these routes were revised.
Lighting and Shadowing: All lighting in Istanbul and the realms of “fıtrat” has been reworked for each graphical setting to achieve a more consistent visual experience. In addition, the new lighting method has greatly improved performance.
The Residences of the Polish Envoy and Köse Ali Pasha: We enhanced the interiors of the residences of the Polish Envoy and Köse Ali Pasha, and also updated the lighting methods to make these areas feel more immersive.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/393aaaec0a20da1ac01012fac4b9183016f01ea3.png
Bug Fixes
[olist]
Dark Shadowing Issue on Medium and Low Settings: When playing on Medium and Low settings, the "Effect Quality" option caused all shadows to appear excessively dark. This problem has been resolved with the new lighting method.
Tahtacılar Mission: During the Tahtacılar mission, if you didn’t interact as required, the mission would fail. Later, if you returned to that area for another mission, the failed Tahtacılar mission would reactivate. Although it didn’t freeze the game, it did disrupt the flow. This issue has been fixed.
Fıtrat Enemies: Some enemies in Fıtrat could fall off platforms, which could freeze the game. This issue has been resolved.
[/olist]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS V0.5 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been over a month since our release, and during this time, we've made many improvements based on your feedback. We've implemented various changes, including bug fixes and new mechanics, making it the largest update we've done so far.

We will continue to improve the game and implement new features and bug fixes. Of course, your feedback is crucial during this period. If you want to report any issues you encounter more quickly, you can email us at developer@5deniz.com.

Here are all the changes that have been made with the v0.5_201023 update:

Visual Improvements:


 The mission screen interface has been updated, and UX has been improved.
 Fixed the glare issue when changing the character's skin tone in the character creation screen.
 Updated the cutscene for the Woodworkers' mission.
 Changed the character animation in the inventory screen.
 Changed the shapes of the Health and Soul bars to spheres.
 Updated the layout of the ability screen interface.
 Simplified the design of the Soul gauge and added it to the death screen.
 Added environment sound specific to the Shishane district.
 Renewed the map.
 Added a sound effect when performing the sliding move.
 Added a sliding rope sound.
 Updated the animation and sound effects for obtaining or failing a mission.
 Added a tool model for sliding ropes.
 Updated the character's sliding rope animation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/665644e0276970c598a3602dde87d2de664ab395.gif
 Updated ability icons.


Mechanical Improvements:


 Nature quests are now added to your quest library as soon as you obtain the compass.
 Added a brief information text about the character's past to the character creation screen.
 Taking fall damage when falling from a height.
 Added a panel in the inventory screen that specifies item attributes.
 Added the ability for the compass to slow down enemies. You need to wait for a certain time to use this ability again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/218eaae8920fb5457384f01ee999a1329f3834f6.gif
 Added a new ability to the sword weapon group. This ability freezes all nearby enemies and attacks them with a sword.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/75a2dad8e889935d6a9065856aca196b3e7daaf4.gif
 Added a new ability to the shield weapon group, allowing us to throw the shield to hit and damage surrounding enemies before it returns to our character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/eb3792908da81f3b29e75fbcf90bfaa6b303c19e.gif
 Introduced the ability to cancel an ability during its use in the ability system.
 Can now spend collected "Essence of Nature" items in the realm of the dead.
 More discoverable items are now available in every corner of Istanbul.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/76dff73834d08c8eb4ef458e974004d23aa52197.gif
 Added more sliding ropes to rooftops.
 Added the mechanic to pick up and throw explosive and poison barrels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/791c3a6d0862de2c2c735931f5d36bc3c8737b0e.gif
 Added enemy spiders to the game.
 Added draggable boxes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/4d33bdf7db08f00ec6015ac2e304a3c503075c60.gif
 Added the ability to initiate a dialogue with the compass.
 Introduced a cinematic skip feature.


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed issues with objects obstructing the camera when entering the area where the slaves are held on the ship.
 Resolved an issue that prevented weapon change keys from working while running in combat mode.
 Fixed the issue that prevented us from breaking objects that should be breakable with a bow.
 Fixed a bug that caused the screen to turn white in unknown areas on the fast map screen.
 The fast map screen used to remain on screen even when the game was paused, and this issue has been fixed.
 Fixed a bug that disrupted the game's camera due to a choice in the Woodworkers' mission.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the ability mode to get stuck when using a controller.
 Fixed an issue where the character reacted as if picking up an item for the first time when removing equipment from the character in the inventory screen.
 Fixed a bug that caused quest markers to appear during cinematics.
 Fixed an issue where the in-game interface was not hidden in some places.
 Fixed a bug that allowed the dialogue to continue when the game was paused during the compass's conversation.
 Fixed a bug that falsely detected the character as being outside the area when using stairs.

We have successfully passed the first weekend in the Early Access phase. We continue to work on improvements by closely monitoring the feedback you provided through comments and plan to leave all the glitches behind in the full version.

With the v0.1_180923 update, the changes and bug fixes we made are as follows:

Visual Improvements


 Excessive glare in the Prologue section has been corrected.
 The lighting of the balcony of St. Andrea Castle has been changed.
 The handrail animation on which our character leans in St. Andrea Castle was flawed, and a minor visual adjustment has been made.


Mechanical Improvements


 "Quick use" slots are now being saved.
 Texts that should appear above characters' heads now appear in the correct places.

 The ability to exit menus with the ESC button has been added.

 In the dialogues with Bergüzar in Galata, there was a sudden FPS drop issue, which has now been resolved.
 In the rooms of Venice Castle, some text bubbles were appearing in the wrong places on the "Memory Mirrors." This issue has been resolved.
 Item prices were displayed incorrectly on the three-dimensional trade screen. This issue has been fixed.

notes.title: Compass of the Destiny: Istanbul | Devlog #5
notes.content:
Next month, we will participate in the WN Conference Istanbul 2023 to promote our game and try to open new doors. During this process, we must polish the game thoroughly and improve the gaming experience. We will strive to keep you informed about the developments we make on this path!

Mechanical Improvements

Staircase system

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1107663419970171022/image4.gif?width=750&height=275

The staircases are now available in Istanbul and on a few Fitrat maps. This development is particularly useful for accessing specific rooftops in Istanbul and will be extensively used in the post system that I will discuss later.

Sliding rope

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1107663420368625754/image5.gif?width=750&height=275

Sliding ropes can be used to reach different discoverable points in Istanbul and Fitrat maps. When thrown to the connecting point on the other side, a rope is formed that links the two points, allowing us to access unreachable areas.

Post system

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1107663419433304165/image3.gif?width=750&height=275

Post areas are located at various points in Istanbul, along your path. These areas can belong to law enforcement and bandits, depending on your "Reputation", which is another aspect of your character. They can be either enemies or allies and if your Reputation is high, law enforcement may act aggressively towards you in that area. 

The choice is yours, whether to proceed stealthily or engage in combat. The same applies to bandit groups, depending on your Reputation level, they will either respect you and do nothing or pose a threat.

Visual Improvements

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1107663417151598722/image6.png?width=670&height=670

The underground area called "Thieves Guild" is now accessible. This area is still under construction and has its own currency and exclusive shops.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1107663417801719818/image1.png?width=670&height=670

The model of "Deccal," a thief with the alias Ali Yahya, whom we encountered on the ship and worked to rescue from prison, has been added to the game. We will encounter him again later in the game.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1107663418766405683/image2.png?width=670&height=670

To make a reference to our other game, RONIN: Two Souls, we have added a Katana to the game. Don't forget to greet us on our social accounts when using it!

notes.title: Compass of the Destiny: Istanbul | Devlog #4
notes.content:
We are getting closer to release. And we will be attending 3 different events in the following 2 months. Wish us good luck!

COD: ISTANBUL DEVLOG #4

Mechanical Improvements

From now on, you can access the "reality mirror" from the Fitrat maps whenever you want. If your enemies have a higher level than you, you can return to the real world with these mirrors. (This situation does not apply to the Fitrat maps in the main mission.)

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1098257114251657276/image6.gif?width=750&height=275

"Memory mirrors" showing us the events that our character experienced in the past, have been added to the Fitrat maps. You can interact with these memory mirrors to watch the past.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1094978323223941244/1098257113278578728/image4.gif?width=750&height=275

The compass now has a slot on the interface. You can use the compass by pressing "C”.

notes.title: Compass of the Destiny: Istanbul | Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello world!

We've completed six months of development and look forward to sharing our progress with the community. Every feedback is invaluable to us, so we look forward to hearing your thoughts and suggestions as we continue to improve our game.

Mechanical Enhancements
[olist]
We have added our key mechanic "Compass" to the game. By accessing it through the hotkey bar, players can activate a unique view that reveals mission locations, points out interactable objects, and highlights friendly and enemy NPCs.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1049863284767076363/1092782849817591818/image2.gif?width=600&height=337

In the Venetian castle, certain events allowed players to experience memories of the past, with multiple NPCs engaging in conversations. Previously, listening to these dialogues was mandatory. We have now revamped the system and placed interactive objects in memory locations. Interacting with these objects now allows players to access memories optionally. (Image not available, under development)

What if I told you we are considering adding Compass abilities beyond the usual ones? Although still in the idea stage, these mostly passive abilities and enhancements would make the game easier for players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/c0713d6f0738842bc9f991e6c90382d50d51d7ce.jpg

Two types of soldiers, "Madman" and "Micho," have received new abilities. Since Madman is a massive enemy, he charges at the player, delivers a powerful ground strike, and knocks the player down if hit. Micho, on the other hand, tosses smoke bombs to obscure himself, becomes invisible for a short period, sneaks up on the player, and deals high damage.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1049863284767076363/1092782849352020079/image1.gif?width=750&height=422
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1049863284767076363/1092782851679858698/image9.gif?width=750&height=422
[/olist]
Visual Enhancements
[olist]
The lighting in the Galata map has been entirely revamped. What once had warm colors now features a more bluish hue.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/910f7c900364cfe9c9a3d5f97320eb16a28100d4.jpg

The design of the prison map has been finalized.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/3aa30d4a87b1ee3a9deddfad6d41a2c9f206a30a.jpg

The map design for Captain Ali Köse Pasha's dream has been completed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/3d4ebd17b42ec4b5e11c25b110da6a9c97dd4f3e.jpg

The lighting in the Venice castle has been updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/4566025aad78d72263cd62f9567f140934760936.jpg

Some cutscenes had improperly positioned cameras, which weakened the narrative impact. As a result, we have redone all cutscenes in general.


The in-game interface has been completely redesigned. We aimed to create a visually aesthetic interface that doesn't burden the player. We tried various options, but we couldn't part with the Diablo-style spherical HP and MP bars. However, their placement on the screen felt too close and unspecial. To address this, we opted for a diamond slice design, inspired by our initial interface concepts.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/acc534ba5e2240459e5c42bab35442481d8cd88e.jpg

Bug Fixes

[olist]
 Several issues plagued the Galata quests and auto-save points, such as NPCs not being in their correct locations or missing dialogues. We have resolved these problems, and all missions have been thoroughly tested.
 All galley missions have been replayed, and any bugs or issues have been addressed.
 Enemy NPCs in the Money and Chest dispositions' combat sections were not spawning correctly. This issue has been resolved.
[/olist]
